finding: Newborn foot length is a highly sensitive tool for diagnosing prematurity at a cut-off of <= 6.8 cm and can predict gestational age in neonates within the first seven days of life, showing a strong positive correlation with gestational age, head circumference, crown-heel length, and birth weight.
cross-section timing: within the first seven days of life
gest_age: Mean of 35.23 +/- 3.59 weeks (estimated by New Ballard Score)
